items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: So sure enough, I went back to Chicago and joined Bert Kelly.

ctx.x: Come on in, yeah. Come on in. I was talking about when you were shoveling snow even. Yeah.
My brother was making it the hard way. So sure enough, I went back to Chicago and joined Bert Kelly. That was another guy on the order, Jack Lane.
Was that Bert Kelly? Was that the stables that he had then? Yeah, that's the stables.
